title: Provide the text of the latest 10 comments to the post with the title 'Anal
question:
Provide the text of the latest 10 comments to the post with the title 'Analysing wind data with R' and the display name of the user who left it.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: the latest comment refers to MAX(CreationDate);

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    c.XCL_008 AS comment_text,
    u.XCL_057 AS display_name
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
JOIN users u ON c.XCL_010 = u.XCL_052
WHERE p.XCL_035 = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.XCL_009 DESC
LIMIT 10
